title: Oily Brazilian Pao Pastry
description: A fresh, crumbly, and festive Brazilian pastry featuring poppy seeds and a unique flavor from bonito flakes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit (190 degrees Celsius).
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
Combine the flour, sugar, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add the softened butter and, using a pastry blender or your fingers, work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
In a small bowl, whisk together the milk and a large egg (if using).
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and gently fold until a shaggy dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead a few times until it comes together.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces and roll each one into a ball.
Place the balls onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving about 1 inch (2.5 cm) of space between each one.
Brush the tops with a little extra milk and sprinkle with toasted poppy seeds.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool on a wire rack for 5-10 minutes before serving.
